author: GoPro
description:
Colby Raha makes history with a new world record, jumping 275 feet over a surf pool before soaring a staggering 90 feet off the ground. This footage puts you directly in Colby's boots as he sends the biggest motocross quarter pipe air ever attempted at the Record Breakers event in Mesa, Arizona.

This uncut POV shows the true scale and intensity, the speed into the ramp, the takeoff, the airtime, and the commitment required to push freestyle motocross into new territory.

Colby's riding continues to raise the bar for motocross and FMX big air. Known for his X Games dominance and progression-driven approach, he once again proves what’s possible on two wheels.

Experience the raw, immersive GoPro POV of a historic motocross moment, captured in 5.6k on the GoPro HERO13 Black Ultra Wide Edition. If you want to experience a motocross world record from the rider’s perspective, this is as close as it gets.
